messages:
Elena: Heads-up  my friend Mateo is coming by for a short pottery demo in MR-C around 11am. Hes bringing a mobile wheel that needs power + water. Also a courier said 3 small boxes of glaze samples arriving ~10:50. Need temp badge and a tidy spot we can protect from splatter. :clay: :package:
Front Desk: We can do that. Please DM full name and phone so we can pre-print. Note: meeting room floors are new so Facilities prefers tarps and a cardboard runner to the door. Also we'll reserve MR-C 11:00-12:00.
Elena: Name: Mateo Cruz, phone 555-6677. He says wheel may arrive a few minutes late (trolley tight). Demo should be ~11:05-11:35.
Courier-Bot: Delivery logged 10:42 for 3 parcels to "GLAZE SAMPLES". Handling: liquid/fragile. ETA 10:50. Recommend reception hold and store upright.
Nora: I can lay down tarps and plastic sheeting at 10:50. Also will bring a big bin for clay scrap and a small broom.
Dmitri: Happy to be lobby escort at 11:00 and help carry the wheel. Also volunteering as demo assistant if Mateo wants a hand.
Front Desk: Pre-printing badge info:
```
Visitor: Mateo Cruz
Company: Guest
Badge: TEMP-MATEO-11AM
Notes: Pottery demo in MR-C. Requires power (15A), access to sink, tarps on floor. Glaze samples arriving.
```
Facilities: Can you confirm MR-C outlet on C-wall is safe for wheel (15A) and bring a GFCI extension? Also wet-vac on standby please.
Facilities: Confirmed outlet capacity. We'll bring a GFCI extension, wet-vac, towels, and a folding dolly. Also placing a carpet protector runner to avoid scuffs. If glazes contain solvents, we'll move them to ventilated storage per MSDS.
Liam: Who wants to try making a pinch pot after the demo? Quick show of hands. :raised_hand: :laughing:
Elena: Mateo says glazes are water-based safe. Hes bringing disposable masks for volunteers if clay dust gets airborne.
Nora: Great  I'll still bring a small HEPA-rated broom and dustpan just in case.
Dmitri: Bringing extra towels and a box of latex gloves.
Front Desk: Badge printed and on A-desk tray. MR-C reserved 11:00-12:00. Well hold glaze parcels in reception until Facilities inspects.
Elena: Amazing, thank you all. Mateo is excited and promised not to turn the demo into a pottery-themed flash mob. :grin:
